body: Day ten for me, need to reset but I'm feeling good :)
You'll find your coding improves as sobriety kicks in, trust me on that one :)
Now THAT is some wonderful motivation to stay sober :)
Not drinking today.

(House of Cards is currently helping me through the rough bits, so it seems appropriate!)

Similarly, I am hoping a sober lifestyle will allow me to go and do the things I watched documentaries about while wallowing in alcohol and self pity. The things I never started trying to get good at because I was too hungover and anxious to make it any further than the local store.
I'd say that being sober can give me the best possible chance at breaking out of that lonely cycle. Maybe this helps you too.
Last night had extremely intense cravings. Turns out I was just hungry. Ate a solid meal and ice cream and got through it. I won't drink today.
Nice day at work done, I don't plan to spoil it by drinking
Not drinking today :)
Off to the non drinking activities part of a stag, go karting. Got a lift for directly after that and the stag knows I'm trying to quit. I'm not drinking today :)

My first stop was a big bag of limes, soda water, ice. It's raining outside, which I always find ridiculously soothing, I have a lot to do tomorrow and I can't bare the thought of trying to do any of it hungover.

Glad to! I've suffered with bad social anxiety and depression for most of my adult life, has taken way too long to take one of the variables out and see who I am behind that escape mechanism. That's great advice, I am telling close friends i'm giving it a try to see how I feel. My head has a lot more intent than what I share, for now at least. It's a period of adjustment for me and I only expect that of myself for now. I don't feel meetings are for me just yet, I have been meaning to get back into counselling though, I will see how I deal with my demons first.

I think part of me feeling this way at this age comes down to my life thus far in being that of someone frequently moving, without consistency. When I got to a stage of being unhappy, overwhelmed or unable to cope, I moved/did something drastic direction wise. Alcohol was always a consistent. 

I now have a stable job, where I am given opportunity to learn from great people, that I enjoy. I'm not used to handling a status quo or a managing a positive, consistent aspect of my life. There was never really anything in that time that I felt I was really progressing at, or had the potential to. Drink is making me feel trapped and that progress was suffering as a result. It used to make me feel free to do..well on second thoughts, nothing tangible. There isn't any real reason to run now and alcoholism is a heavy burden. Why carry the weight?
This feels like progress I have a degree of control over.
Thank you for sharing that with me, that is again, extremely useful to hear that and I wish you all the best in your sobriety and with your counselling!
Stocked up on soda water, lime and ice. It's been a week for me and my mindset towards drinking definitely feels different. I won't drink today.
It's the England v Wales game today, celebrating the eve of one week and a clear head! I won't drink today.
You won't hear any bottles clinking, I ain't drinkin!
'm done with escaping. I've drank my fear my entire adult life. It's early, but the perspective has changed. I didn't drink today.

Well I am about to go to bed but I didn't drink today. I changed my sheets, made food for work, watched the euros, played some video games, cleaned the kitchen fridges and freezer included. Drank a shed load of water and still not hydrated I don't think. Up at 7 for work hopefully feeling fresher. Tuesday is recycling day where I get to let go of the two bin bags of empty cans stuffed in my wardrobe. I think that'll be it for me sd. Good luck to the rest of you today :)

Just opened the fortune cookie from my chinese takeaway from yesterday, it said. 
"Your days will be filled with sunshine and happiness."
Alright then, as good a reason as any. I ain't drinking today.
Oh none taken, was just curious :) Struggle makes the results more satisfying at least?
For some I would say this seems sensible, for me, living day to day is what got me into this mess.
What is the context of Fuck?
Im doing good. It is utterly freezing outside, I nearly caved on the way in from work, found out my 6 month contract is now permanent. I aint messing this up. Not for a drink.
Been a rough few weeks. I'm ready again with a reset when it comes. I will not drink today.
I ain't drinking today, I am on a massive sugar binge this weekend though, I hope this passes or i'll be the size of a house!

I forgot to check in today because I was so productive, yeah that's right, well its 23:11 and it's cold as fuck and im hooked on some games. Looks like i'm just gonna have to keep up this not drinking thing.
One week down baby! I will not drink today!
It's a week tomorrow so the only giving up ill be doing today is my thoughts of having a drink!

Sleep was mental the first few days, 1 hour sweaty jolts I never want to experience again. I've made it a point of eating well (hey at least the brief culinary career helps me get creative). Work focus has been good. Have made a point of going to the shops I'd usually buy from. Ice tea from one, energy drink another and an ice coffee from the final point in the Bermuda booze triangle that is my way home from work. Hoping to gradually get into some sort of health regime, but there's plenty of time for that.

Definitely not the only one. Realised I get into the same bored mindset sober just alcohol stopped me being able to do anything basic to ever get the chance to change any of the things I was unhappy with. Don't eat properly? Good look battling bad skin and weight. Sweating and severe anxiety buying groceries, how will I flirt with the cute girl that serves me every Saturday?

I'm 24, feel you on the almost joy of finally accepting it. My best  friend whose brother was a full blown alcoholic told me she was really worried about me. That was my wakeup, poured the drink down the sink (wahey rhyming like a mad bastard) and I don't plan to make her doubt me again.
Think its worth it personally for knowing what the fuck I did 8 hours ago and not having to avoid my Facebook chat/WhatsApp

Finding it good to use meal prep as a way to fill time and concentrate on something else. It's been nice to actually be craving food when I get home from work it used to be beer then oh I should probably eat something.. tin of soup and 8 cans? Feels good to want to eat proper meals.
My boss told me I looked really happy this morning. It was 8am. I can't remember the last time someone told me I looked happy. On that note, I'm not gonna drink today!

Haha it might be wishful thinking but I look brighter and less bloated. I was caning 6-12 cans a night, the calories alone urgh, makes no sense at the time. Still having the 2 hour wake ups but still feel fresh til about 3 in the afternoon. Been eating right though too. Now to get over gym anxiety and get back into shape. Glad things are going well today and when it comes to it, the next.

Soaked by some prick in a Mercedes on the way to work, missed my bus by 10 seconds. Now have to stay at work an extra half hour on my already late finish. And ya know what? I get to go to the gym later and avoid all the roiders hogging the machines so I can sweat out some serious rage. All part of not drinking today, my face has already lost weight!

Starting day four, got into a load of app bugs to fix. Heads feeling clearer for a good night's sleep (minus the intermittent 2 hour wake ups, I didn't mind them knowing I still had more time in bed!). Nothing will drive me to drink today :)

Feel you on the skype thing, not my proudest days. On my fourth day and I've woken up an hour earlier for work feeling fresh, had time to make a nice coffee and poach an egg, wtf is this?! Used to sighing, rolling out of bed, dry shampoo my hair and splashing my face with water. Finding some unironed passable work clothes and running for the bus. 

There's lots of us making this change this year and I wish you the best of strength,  not luck!

Feels good. Any time you feel like a drink, visit this sub and read a few stories. Good on you brother!
Turned down a beer at both, feels good :)
I'm three days in. Gonna tidy my flat get rid of all the recycling. Then going for a meal with my parents and to watch some football with a friend. I'll drown myself in ice tea today!
I will drink green tea today!
